refusalLedger.why: EXPLICITLY_REFUSED above counts refusals INSIDE the eligible population and is 0. That is not "nothing was refused": the walk refused 72,099 documents, and the live eligibility predicate independently excludes every one of them. Two mechanisms, same verdict, on all of them.

supersededByOngoingIngest.why: NEW2 resumed ingest at ~16:50Z and the incremental queue embedded 109 documents at 17:14:06Z. This census is a SNAPSHOT with a measuredAt, and the corpus moving past it is the system working. "Terminal" describes the coarse backfill reaching its frontier, not a corpus that has stopped growing.
